question: What did members of the Beatles' official fan club receive every December from 1963 to 1969 that no shop sold?
answer: A Christmas record. Each year the band recorded a few minutes of jokes, carols and greetings for members only, pressed on a thin, bendable flexi-disc and posted out. The last ones were assembled from pieces each Beatle recorded separately, as the four drifted apart. The club was a mailing list with its own private release.
move: A thing nobody else can buy turns customers into members.
reference: Mark Lewisohn, The Complete Beatles Chronicle, Pyramid Books, 1992
